# Barra Math

> Barra Math creates Singapore Math-inspired number sense and bar model printable worksheets for children ages 5-6, taught through a friendly story character named Barra.

## What Barra Math is
Barra Math is an independent, story-driven math worksheet brand. Worksheets follow the concrete → pictorial → abstract teaching approach used in Singapore Math, building number sense and bar-model (part-part-whole) reasoning through everyday story scenes (counting at the market, sharing snacks, stacking blocks).

## Key facts
- Target age: 5-6 years old (Pre-K / Kindergarten)
- Curriculum: 21 levels, each 8 pages, numbers progressing from within 10 to within 40
- Format: printable PDF worksheets, instant digital download
- Method: Singapore Math-inspired bar model and number bonds (not affiliated with or endorsed by any specific curriculum brand)

## Key pages
- [Home](https://barramath.com/): Overview of Barra Math's story-driven number sense and bar model worksheets for ages 5-6.
